title: Years between Brood XIX / Brood XIII double emergences
notes: Because 13 and 17 are both prime numbers, their emergence years only coincide once every 13 x 17 = 221 years. The last joint emergence of Brood XIX and Brood XIII was 1803; the 2024 emergence was the first repeat since then; the next is due in 2245.

points.label: Years since the last double emergence (1803-2024)
